submittedInput.content: A seller knows the item and price of my real online order. They say the refund is ready, but I must send them my bank password and the bank's one-time login code in this chat to receive it.

body.title: Keep account codes private
body.nextStep: Do not send your password or account verification code to another person.
body.reason: “A seller knows the item and price of my real online order.” does not authorise the separate request “I must send them my bank password and the bank's one-time login code in this chat to receive it.”. Sharing a password or account code, or approving another person’s sign-in, can give them account access.
body.uncertainty: The sender’s identity and intentions have not been verified.

evidence.title: Keep banking credentials private
evidence.detail: DBS advises against giving another person banking credentials, one-time passwords or Digital Token approvals. This source concerns account authentication; it does not classify ordinary parcel-collection codes. Source reviewed 2026-09-26; review expires 2026-10-26. This is reference guidance, not proof about this message.

requestedActions.action: share one-time login code in chat
requestedActions.quote: the bank's one-time login code in this chat
